content: Good morning, Sunrise Family Clinic, Ana speaking. How can I help you today?
Good morning, Ana. My name is Maria Garcia, and I'd like to book an appointment please.
Nice to meet you, Maria. Do you have a preferred doctor or a specific day in mind for your appointment?
Could I please be scheduled with Doctor Lopez? Any day this week works for me.

We have openings with Dr. Lopez on Tuesday at ten thirty in the morning or Wednesday at nine in the morning. Which would you prefer?I’ll book you for Dr. Lopez on Tuesday at ten thirty in the morning. May I have your full name to confirm?
Yes, that works for me. My full name is Maria Garcia.
Just to confirm: Dr. Lopez on Tuesday at ten thirty in the morning, for Maria Garcia. Shall I go ahead and book that?
Yes, please go ahead and book it.
Your appointment with Dr. Lopez is confirmed for Tuesday at ten thirty in the morning. Have a great day!
Thank you, Ana. Have a great day too!
